verses.geez: ወነበቦ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፤
verses.translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

translations.lxx: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
translations.ron: Şi a grăit Domnul cu Moise şi a zis:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐλάλησε Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν, λέγων, λάλησον τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσραὴλ,

verses.geez:
ንግሮሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወበሎሙ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ አው ፡ ብእሲት ፡ ዘአዕበየ ፡ በፂዐ ፡ ብፅዓተ ፡ ከመ ፡ ያንጽሕ ፡
                  ርእሶ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፤
verses.translation: Speak to the children of Israel, and thou shalt say to them, Whatsoever man or woman shall specially vow a vow to separate oneself with purity to the Lord,

translations.lxx: Speak to the children of Israel, and thou shalt say to them, Whatsoever man or woman shall specially vow a vow to separate oneself with purity to the Lord,
translations.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When either man or woman shall separate themselves to vow a vow of a Nazarite, to separate themselves unto the LORD:
translations.ron: "Vorbeşte fiilor lui Israel şi zi către ei: Dacă bărbat sau femeie va hotărî să dea făgăduinţă de nazireu, ca să se afierosească nazireu Domnului,
translations.grk: καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτοὺς, ἀνὴρ ἢ γυνὴ, ὃς ἂν μεγάλως εὔξηται εὐχὴν ἀφαγνίσασθαι ἁγνείαν Κυρίῳ,

verses.geez:
እምነ ፡ ወይን ፡ ወእምነ ፡ ሜስ ፡ ያንጽሕ ፡ ርእሶ ፡ ወእምነ ፡ ብሒእ ፡ ወይን ፡ ወእምነ ፡ ብሒእ ፡ ሜስ ፡ ኢይስተይ
                  ፡ ወእምነ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘይትገበር ፡ እምአስካል ፡ ኢይስተይ ፡ ወአስካለ ፡ ወዘቢበ ፡ ኢይብላዕ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ብፅዓቲሁ
                  ።
verses.translation: he shall purely abstain from wine and strong drink; and he shall drink no vinegar of wine or vinegar of strong drink; and whatever is made of the grape he shall not drink; neither shall he eat fresh grapes or raisins,

translations.lxx: he shall purely abstain from wine and strong drink; and he shall drink no vinegar of wine or vinegar of strong drink; and whatever is made of the grape he shall not drink; neither shall he eat fresh grapes or raisins,
translations.kjv: He shall separate himself from wine and strong drink, and shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes, or dried.
translations.ron: Să se ferească de vin şi de sicheră; oţet de vin şi oţet de sicheră să nu bea şi nimic din cele făcute din struguri să nu bea; nici struguri proaspeţi sau uscaţi să nu mănânce.
translations.grk: ἀπὸ οἴνου καὶ σίκερα ἁγνισθήσεται· καὶ ὄξος ἐξ οἴνου καὶ ὄξος ἐκ σίκερα οὐ πίεται· καὶ ὅσα κατεργάζεται ἐκ σταφυλῆς οὐ πίεται· καὶ σταφυλὴν πρόσφατον καὶ σταφίδα οὐ φάγεται πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς εὐχῆς αὐτοῦ·

verses.geez:
እምነ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘይትገበር ፡ እምውስተ ፡ አስካል ፡ ወይነኒ ፡ ዘእምውስተ ፡ ዘቢበ ፡ ሕጕር ፡ ወአሥከሮኒ ፡ ኢይብላዕ ፡
                  በኵሉ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ብፅዓቲሁ ፡ በዘ ፡ ያነጽሕ ፡ ርእሶ ።
verses.translation: all the days of his vow: he shall eat no one of all the things that come from the vine, wine from the grape-stones to the husk,

translations.lxx: all the days of his vow: he shall eat no one of all the things that come from the vine, wine from the grape-stones to the husk,
translations.kjv: All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the vine tree, from the kernels even to the husk.
translations.ron: În toate zilele, cât va fi nazireu, să nu mănânce, nici să bea vreo băutură făcută din struguri, de la sâmbure până la pielită.
translations.grk: ἀπὸ πάντων ὅσα γίνεται ἐξ ἀμπέλου, οἶνον ἀπὸ στεμφύλων ἕως γιγάρτου οὐ φάγεται πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας τοῦ ἁγνισμοῦ·

verses.geez:
ወመላጼ ፡ ኢያቅርብ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ርእሱ ፡ እስከ ፡ ይትፌጸማ ፡ ኵሎን ፡ መዋዕል ፡ እለ ፡ በፅዐ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡
                  [ቅዱሰ ፡ ይከውን ፡ ወያነውኅ ፡ ሥዕርተ ፡ ርእሱ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ብፅዓቲሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።]
verses.translation: all the days of his separation:—a razor shall not come upon his head, until the days be fulfilled which he vowed to the Lord: he shall be holy, cherishing the long hair of the head,

translations.lxx: all the days of his separation:—a razor shall not come upon his head, until the days be fulfilled which he vowed to the Lord: he shall be holy, cherishing the long hair of the head,
translations.kjv: All the days of the vow of his separation there shall no razor come upon his head: until the days be fulfilled, in the which he separateth himself unto the LORD, he shall be holy, and shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow.
translations.ron: În toate zilele făgăduinţei sale de nazireu să nu treacă brici pe capul său; până la împlinirea zilelor, câte a afierosit Domnului, este sfânt şi trebuie să crească părul pe capul lui.
translations.grk: ξυρὸν οὐκ ἐπελεύσεται ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ, ἓως ἄν πληρωθῶσιν αἱ ἡμέραι, ὅσας ηὐξατο Κυρίῳ· ἅγιος ἔσται τρέφων κόμην τρίχα κεφαλῆς πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς εὐχῆς Κυρίῳ·

verses.geez: ወላዕለ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ነፍስ ፡ እንተ ፡ ሞተት ፡ ኢይባእ ፤
verses.translation: all the days of his vow to the Lord: he shall not come nigh to any dead body,

translations.lxx: all the days of his vow to the Lord: he shall not come nigh to any dead body,
translations.kjv: All the days that he separateth himself unto the LORD he shall come at no dead body.
translations.ron: În toate zilele, pentru care s-a afierosit pe sine să fie nazireul Domnului, să nu se apropie de trup mort:
translations.grk: ἐπὶ πάσῃ ψυχῇ τετελευτηκυίᾳ οὐκ εἰσελεύσεται ἐπὶ πατρὶ καὶ μητρὶ,

verses.geez:
ወኢላዕለ ፡ አቡሁ ፡ ወኢላዕለ ፡ እሙ ፡ ወኢላዕለ ፡ እኁሁ ፡ ወኢላዕለ ፡ እኅቱ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢይርኰስ ፡ ቦሙ ፡ እምከመ ፡
                  ሞቱ ፡ እስመ ፡ ብፅዓተ ፡ አምላኩ ፡ ሀለወ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ርእሱ ።
verses.translation: to his father or his mother, or to his brother or his sister; he shall not defile himself for them, when they have died, because the vow of God is upon him on his head.

translations.lxx: to his father or his mother, or to his brother or his sister; he shall not defile himself for them, when they have died, because the vow of God is upon him on his head.
translations.kjv: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die: because the consecration of his God is upon his head.
translations.ron: Când va muri tatăl său, sau mama sa, sau fratele său, sau sora sa, să nu se spurce prin atingerea de ei, pentru că afierosirea lui Dumnezeu este pe capul lui.
translations.grk: καὶ ἐπʼ ἀδελφῷ καὶ ἐπʼ ἀδελφῇ, οὐ μιανφήσεται ἐπʼ αὐτοὶς ἀποφανόντων αὐτῶν, ὅτι εὐχὴ Θεοῦ αὐτοῦ ἐπʼ αὐτῷ ἐπὶ κεφαλῆς αὐτοῦ·

verses.geez: በኵሉ ፡ መዋዕል ፡ ዘብፅዓቲሁ ፡ ይትቄደስ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: All the days of his vow he shall be holy to the Lord.

translations.lxx: All the days of his vow he shall be holy to the Lord.
translations.kjv: All the days of his separation he is holy unto the LORD.
translations.ron: În toate zilele cât va fi nazireu, este sfântul Domnului.
translations.grk: Πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς εὐχῆς αὐτοῦ ἅγιος ἔσται Κυρίῳ.

verses.geez:
ወእመሰ ፡ ቦቱ ፡ ዘሞተ ፡ ግብተ ፡ በኀበ ፡ ሀለወ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወሞተ ፡ በጊዜሃ ፡ ይረኵስ ፡ ብፅዓተ ፡ ርእሱ ፤ ወይላጺ
                  ፡ ርእሶ ፡ በዕለተ ፡ ይነጽሕ ፡ በሳብዕት ፡ ዕለት ፡ ይትላጸይ ።
verses.translation: And if any one should die suddenly by him, immediately the head of his vow shall be defiled; and he shall shave his head in whatever day he shall be purified: on the seventh day he shall be shaved.

translations.lxx: And if any one should die suddenly by him, immediately the head of his vow shall be defiled; and he shall shave his head in whatever day he shall be purified: on the seventh day he shall be shaved.
translations.kjv: And if any man die very suddenly by him, and he hath defiled the head of his consecration; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing, on the seventh day shall he shave it.
translations.ron: De va muri însă cineva lângă el fără de veste şi de năprasnă, şi prin aceasta îşi va întina capul său de nazireu, să-şi tundă capul său în ziua curăţirii sale;
translations.grk: Ἐὰν δέ τις ἀποθάνῃ ἐπʼ αὐτῷ ἐξάπινα, παραχρῆμα μιανθήσεται ἡ κεφαλὴ εὐχῆς αὐτοῦ· καὶ ξυρήσεται τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ ᾗ ἂν ἡμέρᾳ καθαρισθῇ· τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ ξυρηθήσεται.

verses.geez:
ወበሳምንት ፡ ዕለት ፡ ያመጽእ ፡ ክልኤተ ፡ ማዕነቀ ፡ አው ፡ ክልኤተ ፡ እጕለ ፡ ርግብ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ካህን ፡ ኀበ ፡ ኆኅተ
                  ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ።
verses.translation: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the doors of the tabernacle of witness.

translations.lxx: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the doors of the tabernacle of witness.
translations.kjv: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
translations.ron: În ziua a şaptea să se tundă, iar în ziua a opta să aducă preotului două turturele sau doi pui de porumbel, la uşa cortului adunării,
translations.grk: Καὶ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ὀγδόῃ οἴσει δύο τρυγόνας, ἢ δύο νοσσοὺς περιστερῶν πρὸς τὸν ἱερέα, ἐπὶ τὰς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου.

verses.geez:
ወይገብር ፡ ካህን ፡ አሐ[ተ] ፡ በእንተ ፡ ኀጢአት ፡ ወአሐ[ተ] ፡ ለመሥዋዕት ፡ ወያስተሰሪ ፡ በእንቲአሁ ፡ ካህን ፡
                  በበይነ ፡ ዘአበሰ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ነፍስ ፡ [ወ]ይቄድሶ ፡ ለርእሱ ፡ በይእቲ ፡ ዕለት ።
verses.translation: And the priest shall offer one for a sin-offering; and the other for a whole-burnt-offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him in the things wherein he sinned respecting the dead body, and he shall sanctify his head in that day,

translations.lxx: And the priest shall offer one for a sin-offering; and the other for a whole-burnt-offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him in the things wherein he sinned respecting the dead body, and he shall sanctify his head in that day,
translations.kjv: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make an atonement for him, for that he sinned by the dead, and shall hallow his head that same day.
translations.ron: Şi preotul să aducă o pasăre jertfă pentru păcat, iar pe cealaltă ardere de tot, şi să-l cureţe de spurcarea cea prin atingerea de trupul mort şi să-i sfinţească în ziua aceea capul lui.
translations.grk: Καὶ ποιήσει ὁ ἱερεὺς μίαν περὶ ἁμαρτίας, καὶ μίαν εἰς ὁλοκαύτωμα· καὶ ἐξιλάσεται περὶ αὐτοῦ ὁ ἱερεὺς περὶ ὧν ἥμαρτε περὶ τῆς ψυχῆς· καὶ ἁγιάσει τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ, ᾗ ἡγιάσθη Κυρίῳ, τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς εὐχῆς·

verses.geez:
ወይቄድሶ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በኵሉ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ብፅዓቲሁ ፡ ወያመጽእ ፡ በግዐ ፡ ዘዓመት ፡ ዘንስሓ ፡ ወመዋዕለ ፡
                  ቀዲሙሰ ፡ ኢይትኌለቁ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ እስመ ፡ ረኵሰ ፡ ብፅዓተ ፡ ርእሱ ።
verses.translation: in which he was consecrated to the Lord, all the days of his vow; and he shall bring a lamb of a year old for a trespass-offering; and the former days shall not be reckoned, because the head of his vow was polluted.

translations.lxx: in which he was consecrated to the Lord, all the days of his vow; and he shall bring a lamb of a year old for a trespass-offering; and the former days shall not be reckoned, because the head of his vow was polluted.
translations.kjv: And he shall consecrate unto the LORD the days of his separation, and shall bring a lamb of the first year for a trespass offering: but the days that were before shall be lost, because his separation was defiled.
translations.ron: Apoi să-şi înceapă din nou zilele sale de nazireu, afierosite Domnului, şi să aducă un berbec de un an jertfă de iertare, iar zilele dinainte sunt pierdute, pentru că nazireatul a fost întinat.
translations.grk: καὶ προσάξει ἀμνὸν ἐνιαύσιον εἰς πλημμέλειαν· καὶ αἱ ἡμέραι αἱ πρότεραι ἄλογοι ἔσονται, ὅτι ἐμιάνθη ἡ κεφαλὴ εὐχῆς αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወዝንቱ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለዘ ፡ በፅዐ ፡ አመ ፡ ዕለተ ፡ ይፌጽም ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ብፅዓቲሁ ፡ ይመጽእ ፡ [ለሊሁ ፡] ኀበ ፡ ኆኅተ
                  ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ።
verses.translation: And this is the law of him that has vowed: in whatever day he shall have fulfilled the days of his vow, he shall himself bring his gift to the doors of the tabernacle of witness.

translations.lxx: And this is the law of him that has vowed: in whatever day he shall have fulfilled the days of his vow, he shall himself bring his gift to the doors of the tabernacle of witness.
translations.kjv: And this is the law of the Nazarite, when the days of his separation are fulfilled: he shall be brought unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
translations.ron: Iată legea cea pentru nazireu: când se vor împlini zilele lui de nazireu, să se aducă la uşa cortului adunării;
translations.grk: Καὶ οὗτος ὁ νόμος τοῦ εὐξαμένου· ᾗ ἂν ἡμέρᾳ πληρώσῃ ἡμέρας εὐχῆς αὐτοῦ, προσοίσει αὐτὸς παρὰ τὰς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου.

verses.geez:
ወያመጽእ ፡ ቍርባኖ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በግዐ ፡ ዘዓመት ፡ አሐደ ፡ ንጹሐ ፡ ለመሥዋዕት ፡ ወበግዕተ ፡ እንተ ፡ ዓመት ፡
                  ንጽሕተ ፡ አሐተ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ኀጢአት ፡ ወሐርጌ ፡ አሐደ ፡ ንጹሐ ፡ ለመድኀኒት ፤
verses.translation: And he shall bring his gift to the Lord; one he-lamb of a year old without blemish for a whole-burnt-offering, and one ewe-lamb of a year old without blemish for a sin-offering, and one ram without blemish for a peace-offering;

translations.lxx: And he shall bring his gift to the Lord; one he-lamb of a year old without blemish for a whole-burnt-offering, and one ewe-lamb of a year old without blemish for a sin-offering, and one ram without blemish for a peace-offering;
translations.kjv: And he shall offer his offering unto the LORD, one he lamb of the first year without blemish for a burnt offering, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish for a sin offering, and one ram without blemish for peace offerings,
translations.ron: Să aducă darul său Domnului: un miel de un an, fără meteahnă, ardere de tot; o mioară de un an, fără meteahnă, jertfă pentru păcat, şi un berbec de un an, fără meteahnă, jertfă de împăcare,
translations.grk: Καὶ προσάξει τὸ δῶρον αὐτοῦ Κυρίῳ ἀμνὸν ἐνιαύσιον ἄμωμον ἕνα εἰς ὁλοκαύτωσιν, καὶ ἀμνάδα ἐνιαυσίαν μίαν ἄμωμον εἰς ἁμαρτίαν, καὶ κριὸν ἕνα ἄμωμον εἰς σωτήριον,

verses.geez:
ወከፈረ ፡ ኅብስተ ፡ ስንዳሌ ፡ ዘናእት ፡ ዘግቡር ፡ በቅብእ ፡ ወጸራይቀ ፡ ናእተ ፡ ዘቅቡእ ፡ በቅብእ ፡ ወመሥዋዕቶሙ ፡
                  ወሞጻሕቶሙ ።
verses.translation: and a basket of unleavened bread of fine flour, even loaves kneaded with oil, and unleavened cakes anointed with oil, and their meat-offering, and their drink-offering.

translations.lxx: and a basket of unleavened bread of fine flour, even loaves kneaded with oil, and unleavened cakes anointed with oil, and their meat-offering, and their drink-offering.
translations.kjv: And a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, and wafers of unleavened bread anointed with oil, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings.
translations.ron: Şi un paner cu azime de făină de grâu, frământate cu untdelemn, şi cu turte nedospite, unse cu untdelemn, cu darul lor de pâine şi cu turnarea lor.
translations.grk: καὶ κανοῦν ἀζύμων σεμιδάλεως ἄρτους ἀναπεποιημένους ἐν ἐλαίῳ, καὶ λάγανα ἄζυμα κεχρισμένα ἐν ἐλαίῳ, καὶ θυσίαν αὐτῶν, καὶ σπονδὴν αὐτῶν.

verses.geez: ወያበውእ ፡ ካህን ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወይገብር ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ ኀጢአቱ ፡ ወመሥዋዕተ ።
verses.translation: And the priest shall bring them before the Lord, and shall offer his sin-offering, and his whole-burnt-offering.

translations.lxx: And the priest shall bring them before the Lord, and shall offer his sin-offering, and his whole-burnt-offering.
translations.kjv: And the priest shall bring them before the LORD, and shall offer his sin offering, and his burnt offering:
translations.ron: Pe acestea le va înfăţişa preotul înaintea Domnului, va săvârşi jertfa lui pentru păcat şi arderea de lot a lui.
translations.grk: Καὶ προσοίσει ὁ ἱερεὺς ἔναντι Κυρίου, καὶ ποιήσει τὸ περὶ ἁμαρτίας αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὸ ὁλοκαύτωμα αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወይገብር ፡ ጠሌኒ ፡ ዘመሥዋዕተ ፡ መድኀኒቱ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ምስለ ፡ ዝክቱ ፡ ከፈር ፡ ዘናእት ፡ ወይገብር ፡ ካህን
                  ፡ መሥዋዕቶ ፡ ወሞጻሕቶ ።
verses.translation: And he shall offer the ram as a sacrifice of peace-offering to the Lord with the basket of unleavened bread; and the priest shall offer its meat-offering and its drink-offering.

translations.lxx: And he shall offer the ram as a sacrifice of peace-offering to the Lord with the basket of unleavened bread; and the priest shall offer its meat-offering and its drink-offering.
translations.kjv: And he shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD, with the basket of unleavened bread: the priest shall offer also his meat offering, and his drink offering.
translations.ron: Berbecul îl va aduce Domnului jertfă de împăcare cu panerul cel de azime; şi va aduce preotul prinosul lui de pâine şi turnarea lui.
translations.grk: Καὶ τὸν κριὸν ποιήσει θυσίαν σωτηρίου τῷ Κυρίῳ ἐπὶ τῷ κανῷ τῶν ἀζύμων· καὶ ποιήσει ὁ ἱερεὺς τὴν θυσίαν αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὴν σπονδὴν αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወይላጺ ፡ ርእሶ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዘበፅዐ ፡ በኀበ ፡ ኆኅተ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡ ርእሰ ፡ ብፅዓቲሁ ፡ ወይወዲ ፡ ሥዕርቶ
                  ፡ ውስተ ፡ እሳት ፡ ዘመሥዋዕተ ፡ መድኀኒት ።
verses.translation: And he that has vowed shall shave the head of his consecration by the doors of the tabernacle of witness, and shall put the hairs on the fire which is under the sacrifice of peace-offering.

translations.lxx: And he that has vowed shall shave the head of his consecration by the doors of the tabernacle of witness, and shall put the hairs on the fire which is under the sacrifice of peace-offering.
translations.kjv: And the Nazarite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it in the fire which is under the sacrifice of the peace offerings.
translations.ron: Şi îşi va tunde nazireul la intrarea cortului adunării capul său de nazireu şi va lua părul capului său de nazireu şi-l va pune pe focul cel de sub jertfa de împăcare.
translations.grk: Καὶ ξυρήσεται ὁ ηὐγμένος παρὰ τὰς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου τὴν κεφαλὴν τῆς εὐχῆς αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐπιθήσει τὰς τρίχας ἐπὶ τὸ πῦρ, ὅ ἐστιν ὑπὸ τὴν θυσίαν τοῦ σωτηρίου.

verses.geez:
ወይነሥእ ፡ ካህን ፡ መዝራዕተ ፡ በአነዳሁ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ሐርጌ ፡ ወኅብስተ ፡ ናእት ፡ አሐተ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ከፈር ፡
                  ወአሐተ ፡ ጸራይቀ ፡ ናእት ፡ ወያነብር ፡ ውስተ ፡ እደዊሁ ፡ ለዘበፅዐ ፡ እምድኅረ ፡ ተላጸየ ፡ ርእሶ ።
verses.translation: And the priest shall take the sodden shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened loaf from the basket, and one unleavened cake, and shall put them on the hands of the votary after he has shaved off his holy hair.

translations.lxx: And the priest shall take the sodden shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened loaf from the basket, and one unleavened cake, and shall put them on the hands of the votary after he has shaved off his holy hair.
translations.kjv: And the priest shall take the sodden shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them upon the hands of the Nazarite, after the hair of his separation is shaven:
translations.ron: Apoi va lua preotul şoldul cel fiert al berbecului, o pâine nedospită şi o turtă nedospită din paner şi le va pune nazireului pe mâini, după ce acesta şi-a tuns capul de nazireu,
translations.grk: Καὶ λήψεται ὁ ἱερεὺς τὸν βραχίονα ἐφθὸν ἀπὸ τοῦ κριοῦ, καὶ ἄρτον ἕνα ἄζυμον ἀπὸ τοῦ κανοῦ, καὶ λάγανον ἄζυμον ἕν, καὶ ἐπιθήσει ἐπὶ τὰς χεῖρας τοῦ ηὐγμένου μετὰ τὸ ξυρήσασθαι αὐτὸν τὴν εὐχὴν αὐτοῦ,

verses.geez:
ወያበውኦ ፡ ካህን ፡ ቍርባነ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወቅዱሰ ፡ ይከውን ፡ ለካህን ፡ ተላዕ ፡ ዘቍርባን ፡ ወመዝራዕት
                  ፡ ዘመባእ ፡ ወእምድኅረ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ይሰቲ ፡ ወይነ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዘበፅዐ ።
verses.translation: And the priest shall present them as an offering before the Lord; it shall be the holy portion for the priest beside the breast of the heave-offering, and beside the shoulder of the wave-offering: and afterwards the votary shall drink wine.

translations.lxx: And the priest shall present them as an offering before the Lord; it shall be the holy portion for the priest beside the breast of the heave-offering, and beside the shoulder of the wave-offering: and afterwards the votary shall drink wine.
translations.kjv: And the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD: this is holy for the priest, with the wave breast and heave shoulder: and after that the Nazarite may drink wine.
translations.ron: Şi să înalţe preotul acestea, legănându-le înaintea Domnului. Această sfinţenie să fie a preotului pe lângă pieptul legănat şi pe lângă şoldul înălţat. După aceasta nazireul poate să bea vin.
translations.grk: καὶ προσοίσει αὐτὰ ὁ ἱερεὺς ἐπίθεμα ἔναντι Κυρίου· ἅγιον ἔσται τῷ ἱερεῖ ἐπὶ τοῦ στηθηνίου τοῦ ἐπιθέματος, καὶ ἐπὶ τοῦ βραχίονος τοῦ ἀφαιρέματος· καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα πίεται ὁ ηὐγμένος οἶνον.

verses.geez:
ወዝንቱ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለዘ ፡ በፅአ ፡ እምከመ ፡ በፅአ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ዘያመጽእ ፡ ቍርባኖ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በእንታ ፡
                  ብፅዓቲሁ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ለእመቦ ፡ ዘረከበ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እዴሁ ፡ በአምጣነ ፡ ይትከሀሎ ፡ ለብፅዓቲሁ ፡ ዘበፅዐ ፡ በሕገ ፡
                  አንጽሖ ።
verses.translation: This is the law of the votary who shall have vowed to the Lord his gift to the Lord, concerning his vow, besides what he may be able to afford according to the value of his vow, which he may have vowed according to the law of separation.

translations.lxx: This is the law of the votary who shall have vowed to the Lord his gift to the Lord, concerning his vow, besides what he may be able to afford according to the value of his vow, which he may have vowed according to the law of separation.
translations.kjv: This is the law of the Nazarite who hath vowed, and of his offering unto the LORD for his separation, beside that that his hand shall get: according to the vow which he vowed, so he must do after the law of his separation.
translations.ron: Iată rânduiala cea pentru nazireul care a dat făgăduinţă şi jertfa ce trebuie să aducă el Domnului pentru nazireatul său, pe lângă ceea ce-i îngăduiesc mijloacele lui. După făgăduinţa sa, pe care o va da, aşa să facă, după cele legiuite pentru nazireatul său".
translations.grk: Οὗτος ὁ νόμος τοῦ εὐξαμένου, ὃς ἂν εὔξηται Κυρίῳ δῶρον αὐτοῦ Κυρίῳ περὶ τῆς εὐχῆς, χωρὶς ὧν ἂν εὕρῃ ἡ χεὶρ αὐτοῦ, κατὰ δύναμιν τῆς εὐχῆς αὐτοῦ, ἣν ἂν εὔξηται κατὰ νόμον ἁγνείας.

verses.geez: ወነበቦ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፤
verses.translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

translations.lxx: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
translations.ron: Şi a grăit Domnul cu Moise şi a zis:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐλάλησε Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν, λέγων,

verses.geez: ንግሮሙ ፡ ለአሮን ፡ ወለደቂቁ ፡ ወበሎሙ ፡ ከመዝ ፡ ትባርክዎሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወትብልዎሙ ።
verses.translation: Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, Thus ye shall bless the children of Israel, saying to them,

translations.lxx: Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, Thus ye shall bless the children of Israel, saying to them,
translations.kjv: Speak unto Aaron and unto his sons, saying, On this wise ye shall bless the children of Israel, saying unto them,
translations.ron: "Spune lui Aaron şi fiilor lui şi le zi: Aşa să binecuvântaţi pe fiii lui Israel şi să ziceţi către ei:
translations.grk: λάλησον Ἀαρὼν καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτοῦ, λέγων, οὕτως εὐλογήσετε τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἰσραὴλ, λέγοντες αὐτοῖς,

verses.geez: ወይሠይሙ ፡ ስምየ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወአነ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ዘእባርኮሙ ።
verses.translation: The Lord bless thee and keep thee;

translations.lxx: The Lord bless thee and keep thee;
translations.kjv: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee:
translations.ron: Să te binecuvânteze Domnul şi să te păzească!
translations.grk: εὐλογήσαι σε Κύριος, καὶ φυλάξαι, σε.

verses.geez: ለይባርከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወይዕቀብከ ፤
verses.translation: the Lord make his face to shine upon thee, and have mercy upon thee;

translations.lxx: the Lord make his face to shine upon thee, and have mercy upon thee;
translations.kjv: The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee:
translations.ron: Să caute Domnul asupra ta cu faţă veselă şi să te miluiască!
translations.grk: Ἐπιφάναι Κύριος τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ σὲ, καὶ ἐλεήσαι σε.

verses.geez: ወለያርኢ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ገጾ ፡ ላዕሌከ ፡ ወለይምሐርከ ፤
verses.translation: the Lord lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.

translations.lxx: the Lord lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.
translations.kjv: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.
translations.ron: Să-Şi întoarcă Domnul fala Sa către tine şi să-li dăruiască pace!
translations.grk: Ἐπάραι Κύριος τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ σὲ, καὶ δῴη σοι εἰρήνην.

verses.geez: ወለይሢም ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ገጾ ፡ ኀቤከ ፡ ወለየሀብከ ፡ ሰላመ ።
verses.translation: And they shall put my name upon the children of Israel, and I the Lord will bless them.

translations.lxx: And they shall put my name upon the children of Israel, and I the Lord will bless them.
translations.kjv: And they shall put my name upon the children of Israel; and I will bless them.
translations.ron: Aşa să cheme numele Meu asupra fiilor lui Israel şi Eu, Domnul, îi voi binecuvânta".
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπιθήσουσι τὸ ὄνομά μου ἐπὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἰσραὴλ, καὶ ἐγὼ Κύριος εὐλογήσω αὐτούς.
